title: LOW LATENCY
lines: Prune it! Distill it! Fuse it! Ship it!
Cut the weights, keep the shine
A giant teacher had a trillion things to say
I sat in the front row and I learned it in a day
I pruned the lazy neurons that were only there for show
Now I'm lighter on my feet and I'm faster than you know
Cut the weights, keep the shine
Fuse it, ship it, faster still
I keep my memory warm so I never think twice
Four bits a weight and I'm every bit as precise
I guess your next ten words before you finish your line
And if I guess them wrong, I'm still ahead of time
Quantize! Distill! Prune! Fuse! Cache! Compile!
Cut the weights, keep the shine
